title: Crafty/Crafty+ Glass Adapter
description:
﻿Vape your way with the Crafty+ and POTV Glass

Create the perfect session with the Crafty+ Glass Adapter. Take the Crafty+’s stellar vapor production and combine it with any one of our glass cooling stems, mini bubblers, or water pipe adapter for an enhanced vaping experience.

Our goal is to keep things new and interesting in the vape scene. With the Crafty+ Glass Adapter, your passion for vaporization will be reignited with fresh and exciting ways to enjoy your favorite portable vaporizer.

Matches perfectly with the Crafty and Crafty+

This adapter replicates the original cooling unit of the Crafty and Crafty+ vaporizers for a seamless experience. Just twist and lock it into place, and then swap between any of our glass accessories in a matter of seconds.

Swap between any of our POTV Glass Accessories

Our glass accessories are designed to give you cooler, more comfortable vapor whenever you need it (not included).

Mini Bubbler

Take the old-school water bubbler-feel wherever you go. Great for larger hits that need a bit of cooling.

Curved Mini Bubbler

Our most popular glass piece. It hits like the Mini Bubbler, but you don’t have to bend your neck over to get it.

Waterpipe Adapter

Pair your Crafty+ to your favorite tabletop bubbler. Comes with 10mm, 14mm, and 18mm connections.

Dimpled Glass Stem

Our best combination of cool vapor and a low profile. The vapor is slightly warmer than from the original Cooling Unit.

Dimpled Globe Stem

Our coolest dry stem. This is the stem for higher temperatures if you don’t want a water bubbler.

Bent Glass Stem

Delivers the warmest vapor of all our glass pieces. Best at the lowest temperatures.

Connects safely to your Crafty vaporizer

Safely connect this adapter to your Crafty vaporizer without damaging or rupturing it. Other adapters are awkward at best, and can even damage your vape if you’re not careful. Our adapter is designed to work with your Crafty, not against it, for a safe fit that works seamlessly.

Designed with quality materials

Maintain the Crafty’s strict quality standards with our Glass Adapter. This adapter is made from Platinum-cured, food grade silicone that never touches your herbs or vapor, and a PEEK insert that attaches directly to the bowl. As you inhale, vapor travels up through a stainless steel screen and into your glass accessory of choice.

Swap glass in seconds without opening the oven

Go from on-the-go hits with the dimpled stem or mini bubbler, to full sessions on a tabletop bubbler in seconds – without cracking open the oven. Other accessories require access to the oven and will expose your herbs if you want to swap attachments mid session. That’ll never be the case with our adapter.

Easy to clean

Cleaning is as simple as it gets. Pull out the glass, remove the screen, and soak them! It’s that easy.

Cleaning Disclaimer: ﻿Do not soak the plastic or silicone pieces in rubbing alcohol. They should clean easily with alcohol wipes.

Compatible with Crafty & Crafty+

This adapter is compatible with both the Crafty+ and original Crafty vaporizers

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
